function.arguments: {"reflection":"The first pass supplies a usable core: DOJ indictment allegations about the organization, funding, deception, infrastructure, candidate orientation, ads/rallies, and named defendants; Senate Volume II assessments; and Oxford/Graphika aggregate reach, timing, platform, and narrative findings.
